trial_court: Court of Sonica Meena, Judicial Magistrate First Class (NI Act) Digital Court-02 (South-West), Dwarka Court, New Delhi. Case No.: CC NI ACT 10465/2021; CNR No.: DLSW020237182021
facts_of_case: Complainant Mahavir Kaushik filed a complaint against accused Neeraj Rohilla under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881. The complainant alleged that the accused bounced a cheque given as a friendly loan.

legal_principles.principle: The accused has rendered himself liable to an offence punishable under Section 138 NI Act.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, in these circumstances, the accused has rendered himself liable to an offence punishable under Section 138 NI Act and he should be punished for the same.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the accused to create doubt in the complainant's case.
legal_principles.held: The case of the complainant stands proved and accused has failed to create doubt on the case of the complainant
use_in: cases where complainant's evidence is challenged

outcome.final_order: The complainant's complaint was allowed and the accused was convicted.
